mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds rate above 4% in the month preceding the prediction is associated with higher discount rates for future cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.0% in the prior month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive or flat despite FEDFUNDS > 4% for ≥ 3 consecutive months prior.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment claims (PAYEMS) accompanied by a simultaneous decline in consumer payrolls (GDPC1) indicate weakening labor market strength, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases while GDPC1 decreases in the same month
failure_condition: Rank IC > 0.05 over 60-day horizon or SPX 60d returns positive when labor indicators show this pattern.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly surge in home sales (HOUST) exceeding 10% year-over-year suggests resilient consumer demand, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns negative despite HOUST YoY > 10% in the trigger month.

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive decline in industrial production (INDPRO) of 2% or more over two months signals supply-side weakness, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decreases for two consecutive months by ≥ 2%
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns positive when INDPRO declines as described.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) below 200 for three consecutive months suggests disinflation, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns negative despite CPIAUCSL meeting the trigger.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment (UNRATE) above 6.5% and a decline in payrolls (PAYEMS) below 200K indicate labor market weakness, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns positive when both indicators meet the trigger.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in retail sales (assumed proxy via GDPC1) of over 8% in a month is interpreted as strong demand, predicting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns negative despite GDPC1 meeting the trigger.

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged decline in manufacturing activity (RSAFS) of 4% or more over 3 months suggests supply constraints, which is expected to produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS decreases for three months by ≥ 4%
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns positive when RSAFS declines as specified.
